collection.description: The Epic of Anzu, Standard Babylonian version, read line by line on photographed clay tablets, with each tablet's own transliteration and B. R. Foster's English translation from the electronic Babylonian Library.

texts.title: Anzu, Standard Babylonian Tablet I: the theft of the Tablet of Destinies
texts.date_approx: composed early 2nd millennium BCE; tablets 18th-7th c. BCE
texts.source: British Museum and Yale Peabody Museum tablet photographs + eBL manuscript transliterations (eBL corpus edition L I.10, Anzu, SB I) + English of the eBL edition (B. R. Foster (eBL edition))
texts.description: The Epic of Anzu, Standard Babylonian Tablet I: 183 of 201 lines, each shown on a photographed cuneiform tablet (4 tablets), with the eBL transliteration of that tablet and B. R. Foster's English translation.
